packages.label: icon-sets-flag
packages.description: 271 country flag SVGs sourced from lipis/flag-icons, available in 4x3 and 1x1 aspect ratios. Replaces the flag half of the deprecated simtabi/laflamoji.

packages.label: icon-sets-openmoji
packages.description: OpenMoji emoji in two sets (colour and black outline), Unicode emoji 16.0, grouped by Unicode CLDR category. Moved verbatim from ichava/icon-sets-twemoji.

packages.label: icon-sets-tabler
packages.description: Over 5,200 pixel-perfect icons for web apps. Free and open source icons designed with attention to detail to make your design stand out.

packages.label: icon-sets-twemoji
packages.description: Twemoji, Twitter/X's open-source emoji set, as SVG. Unicode 17 / Emoji 17 spec. Categorised by Unicode CLDR groups. OpenMoji is in ichava/icon-sets-openmoji.
